description: This is a React component source file (index.tsx) that sets up routing, dynamic component loading, and application-wide hooks and configurations for a chat application. It includes route definitions for chat features, theme switching, localization, and GUI components like sidebars and loading indicators.

methods.name: useHtmlLang
methods.description: A React hook that sets the HTML document's language attribute according to the current ISO language.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: A React hook that returns a boolean indicating whether the component has mounted/hydrated.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: Function that dynamically loads Google Fonts by injecting a stylesheet link into the document head.
